job: Show a list of options a person can choose from.
purpose: The option list a combobox opens, and the list inside any picker: fd-option rows with a check for the selected one, an optional description and mono meta, group labels and an empty message. The active row is marked with data-active. It is a popover that falls back to an absolute panel where the Popover API is missing.
useWhen: Building a picker or menu whose rows are choices with state (selected, active).
Rows need a description, an icon or a mono meta beside the label.

avoidWhen.when: A user needs a ready-made field with typing and filtering.
The rows are actions, not choices.
The rows are plain choices from a short list.
The rows are checkboxes or radios in a form.

variants.useWhen: The list opens above its field, when there is no room below.

parts.role: The list of rows, also used for checkbox groups.
The check on the selected option.
The message when no option matches.

keyboard.does: Move the active option when it belongs to a combobox.
